artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Andrew
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring various sketched figures in a crowded environment. The scene includes people engaged in activities, possibly construction or a ceremony. In the background, there are figures on pedestal-like structures with statues or sculptures atop them. Two central figures on elevated platforms are preparing to take action, with additional figures around them. The drawing captures a bustling atmosphere with individuals involved in different activities, depicted with fine and loose pen strokes.

artworks.title: Saint James the Great
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered in a scene. The drawing features figures engaged in activities or gestures. The use of delicate lines suggests an unfinished sketch, focusing on capturing the essence of motion and interaction. Elements in the scene include architectural details in the background. The central figure is in a kneeling position, adding a focal point to the composition. The style of the drawing suggests a traditional or classical approach, with an emphasis on perspective and arrangement within the space.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son, 6th plate (L'enfant prodigue)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body in a kneeling posture. He has a pensive demeanor, with his head resting on one hand while holding a staff with the other. The man has rugged facial features, a bushy beard, and curly hair, and is wearing a simple, sleeveless garment. The background is a natural landscape with rolling hills and a sky streaked with clouds. The etching style of the image gives it a textured, detailed appearance.

artworks.title: Finding the Sheep (Le mouton retrouve)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a low horizon line that aligns with trees and a stone barricade. The style features delicate linework, resembling a sketch or light etching, with a monochromatic color palette. A figure is depicted kneeling in the foreground, surrounded by scattered objects, while slim trees in the distance create a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Monks Chopping Wood (Les moines bucherons)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image features a man woodworking on a log in a forest clearing. The man is dressed in a long garment and is being observed by three other figures in similar attire.

artworks.title: Head of a Man (Tete d'homme)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of an individual's head and neck. The person is shown in profile, with their head turned to the right and eyes looking down. The individual has wavy, shoulder-length hair, a pronounced nose, and detailed eyes. The drawing ends just below the neck, omitting the shoulders and chest. The background is plain and light beige in color, with the artist's signature, "A. Legros," visible in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Woman Seated against a Wall, Child with His Head in Her Lap (Femme assise, muraille au fond, enfant la tete dans son giron
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows two people, both depicted from the waist up. The person on the left is seated and slightly turned towards the right, wearing a heavy hooded garment that conceals most of their features, revealing a lined face with deep-set, downward-looking eyes. Next to them, a younger individual is also seated, their head resting on their arms, which are folded on their lap. They have curly, short hair, and their face is not fully visible due to their position. This person is dressed in a simple, long-sleeved shirt and knee-length pants. The setting appears to be a stone or brick structure, suggested by the column-like shapes and textured walls in the background, creating a somber and enclosed atmosphere.

artworks.title: Val Prinsep, R.A.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man from the waist up in profile. The man is portrayed as seated and leaning slightly back. He has wavy hair, a full beard and mustache. His head is turned to the side, facing right with his gaze directed outside the frame. The man has a prominent brow, a slightly hooked nose, and a high forehead. He is wearing a long coat over a shirt, with his left hand resting on his clothing near his stomach. The background is plain without distinct features or objects.

artworks.title: View of a Farm (La ferme de Beauchamp)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a hiker on a path, gently rolling terrain, houses, trees, and the sun to the right. The sky has light lines suggesting clouds and sun rays. The artwork uses delicate line work and hatching with a monochromatic sepia color palette for a warm, rustic feel.

artworks.title: Sleeping Shepherd (Le repos du berger)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a landscape with a reclining figure on rocky terrain. The figure, dressed in rustic attire and a hat, is on the right. In the background, there are trees and a fortified structure with towers and walls on the left. The sky is minimally depicted with fine lines suggesting clouds. The artwork is detailed with cross-hatching and flowing lines defining the elements. The color palette is limited to sepia and black, typical of an etching.

artworks.title: Fire in the Hamlet (L'incendie du hameau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman caught in a strong wind. Their clothing and hair are being swept in the direction of the gusts. In the background, there are buildings covered in smoke or clouds. The brushstrokes are detailed, creating texture and movement in the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and black.

artworks.title: Frederic Regamey
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a side-profile sketch of a man showing his head, neck, and shoulders. He is facing to the left, with his body slightly turned in that direction. The man has defined facial features with a prominent nose and a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. His hair appears short and styled, with visible texture and volume. He is wearing a collared shirt with a jacket draped over his shoulders. The sketch is monochromatic, using pencil shading and line work to depict the man's features and clothing. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Head of a Model (Tete de modele)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a profile portrait of a man, focusing on his head and upper shoulders. The man is positioned in right profile, facing towards the right side of the image. His facial features include a prominent nose, expressive eyes looking forward, and a long, full beard. His hair is short and appears to be somewhat curly or textured. The man's attire is not visible. There is no visible jewelry or objects held by the person. In the background, the image has a plain, neutral tone with a subtle texture.

artworks.title: Breton Peasant (Paysan breton)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a line drawing of an elderly man shown in profile from the shoulders up. He faces to the right with his head slightly tilted forward. The man has distinct facial features, including a pronounced nose, deep-set eyes, and a full beard. His long hair flows from beneath a wide-brimmed hat covering most of his head. He wears a coat, indicated by collar lines. No visible jewelry or objects are present. The background is plain, highlighting the man's face and attire. The drawing is signed "A. Legros" in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Little Marie (La petite Marie)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is an etching showing the head and shoulders of a young girl. Her body is shown from the chest up, and she is positioned facing straight towards the viewer. The girl has long, wavy hair that falls down past her shoulders, and she has delicate facial features with a round face, full cheeks, and a small mouth. Her eyes appear dark and are gazing ahead. She is wearing a garment with a high collar, detailed with fine pleats or gathers around the neckline. The background is plain and somewhat textured. The artist's signature, "A. Legros," is present in the upper right corner of the image.

artworks.title: M. Champfleury
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man. The man's upper body is visible, down to just below his shoulders. He is facing slightly to the right of the frame, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a mustache, small round glasses, short combed-back hair, and is wearing formal attire, including a suit, a faintly sketched shirt, and what appears to be a cravat or bow tie. The drawing is done in a sketch-like manner, with soft lines and shading. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain and neutral. In the lower right corner, the drawing is signed "A. Legros 1875."

artworks.title: Head of a Man (Tete d'homme)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed drawing of a man's head and neck in profile view, focusing on the left side of the face. The man's facial features include a well-defined nose, mouth, beard, mustache, and visible eyes. The hair is short and slightly wavy, cut close to the scalp. The drawing highlights outlines and shading in the hair and facial hair, with a blank background emphasizing the head. No clothing, jewelry, or accessories are visible.

artworks.title: Jules Dalou, 1st plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image portrays a man's head and shoulders in a three-quarter view facing right. The man has a strong nose, a full beard, and a mustache. His hair is curly and combed back. He is wearing a collared shirt with minimal details indicated by a few lines. The background is plain, with the artist's signature, "A. Legros," present in the top left and bottom right corners of the image.

artworks.title: Communion in the Church of Saint Medard (La communion dans l'eglise St.-Medard)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with figures engaged in an activity. The image depicts an interior space with architectural features like arches and an alcove. In the foreground, there are figures, one holding an object resembling a chalice, while another holds a staff or sword. Draped garments fall around the figures. The background shows framed art on the walls, indicating a space of significance. The drawing uses fine lines and crosshatching for depth and texture.

artworks.title: The Refectory (Le refectoire)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows seven monks seated around a rectangular table in a dining setting. Most are on wooden stools, while one sits on a bench at the end of the table. Their heads are either hooded or bald. One monk has his hands clasped in prayer, and others are serving or passing food items. The man standing leans over the table. They all wear robes typical of monastic settings. In the background, there is a crucifix under an arched ceiling. The room is simply furnished, with a jug on the floor and light coming in through a small window on the right.

artworks.title: The Death of Saint Francis (La mort de St. Francois)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays five figures in robes, possibly depicting monks or religious individuals. One man lies on the ground, partially propped up, while four others stand around him. The reclining man has a bearded face and open eyes, looking upwards. His robe has long sleeves, and he extends one hand. The others closely observe him, with one man holding a book and leaning in. The background shows trees and a landscape extending to the horizon. A skeletal object is seen on the ground near the reclining man.

artworks.title: Choristers, 1st plate (Le lutrin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of individuals in clerical attire engaged in a religious service. The figures are closely grouped together, and one is holding an open book that appears to be a hymnal or religious text. The scene is composed in stark detail with heavy use of line shading, imparting a solemn, reverent atmosphere. The clothing is rendered with fine lines, accentuating the textures of the robes. There is a sense of solemnity and order suggested by their concentrated expressions and the ceremonial nature of their actions. The drawing captures a particular moment of religious observance, reflecting a historical or traditional setting.

artworks.title: Choristers, 2nd plate (Le lutrin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows three male figures. The man in the foreground stands slightly turned to the right, focusing on a large book. He wears a skullcap and a cloak fastened at the shoulder by a clasp, with a long, full beard. He holds a closed book in his left hand. Behind him, another man stands in a similar orientation, with short hair and gentle features, holding a staff with a decorative top in his right hand. This man wears ecclesiastical garb. In the foreground, a young boy faces the viewer with a neutral expression, holding a staff. He wears a shorter cloak. In the background, there is a wooden structure to the left, with a textured setting for the figures. The overall background is filled with parallel lines, likely suggesting a wall or neutral backdrop.

artworks.title: Baptism
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in profile, showcasing their upper bodies. The center person is slightly to the right with their head turned downward, eyes closed or downcast. They have short, neatly arranged hair with a cloth or bandana tied around their head, and wear a cloak with a visible clasp. The person on the right, an older man, has a strong nose and beard, head bowed slightly forward, wearing a heavy, dark cloak and with hands clasped together. The person on the left, also an older man, has a prominent nose and thin lips, head and shoulders turned slightly towards the center, wearing a dark cap and a garment with a visible collar. The background is a textured, dark space with vertical lines suggesting architectural elements.
